translations.web: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
translations.bsb: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
translations.kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on ➔ your behalf.
translations.asv: Show ye therefore unto them in the face of the churches the proof of your love, and of our glorying on your behalf.
